name: The Shattered Hand
summary: In Orgrimmar, Therzok tests rogues seeking a place in the Shattered Hand. He asks them to open Tazan's recovered satchel with a key taken from an unwitting accomplice.

sections.title: A Test of Subtlety
sections.body: After retrieving Tazan's locked satchel, you find it useless without the key. The Shattered Hand demands skill, not brute force against the complex lock. Therzok sends you to Gamon, a tauren drunkard who frequents Orgrimmar's tavern. Gamon is easily distracted and once helped Tazan, making him a fitting mark for quiet theft.

sections.title: Welcome to the Shadows
sections.body: Take the key from Gamon without alerting the tavern, then open the satchel and claim Tazan's logbook. Bring the stolen contents to Therzok in the Cleft of Shadow to meet the Shattered Hand's standards. A clean job earns you formal recognition as one of its operatives.

faq.q: Who is Gamon and why does he have the key?
faq.answer: Gamon once assisted Tazan, the operative Therzok is investigating. While Tazan carried the satchel, he left its key with Gamon, an unsuspecting drunkard who spends his days drinking in Orgrimmar's central tavern.
Tazan's logbook lies inside the locked satchel. It holds intelligence of interest to Therzok and the Shattered Hand, and recovering it tests your ability to secure vital information covertly.

faq.q: What is the Shattered Hand in Orgrimmar?
faq.answer: The Shattered Hand began as an infamous orcish clan from Draenor, known for self-mutilation and ruthlessness. In Orgrimmar, it has become the Horde's guild of assassins, spies, and rogues, working from the subterranean Cleft of Shadow.
Therzok works from the Cleft of Shadow, a dim cavern network beneath Orgrimmar's rocky ridges. Warlocks, rogues, and shadowcraft gather there, away from daylight.

faq.q: Why doesn't Therzok just break open the satchel?
faq.answer: The satchel has a complex lock, and Therzok is testing a rogue's discipline. The Shattered Hand prizes precise theft and finesse over noisy destruction.
Handing over Tazan's logbook completes your initiation. Therzok recognizes you as a member of the Shattered Hand and gives you tools for covert work.

angles.text: As a rogue, you learn to stalk an unaware target in a crowded place, take a key unnoticed, and secure vital intelligence.
Beneath the martial honor of Thrall's new Horde, covert reconnaissance remains necessary. The Shattered Hand handles it quietly from deep within Orgrimmar.
